 t h e   s u r v i v o r   g i r l   a n d   h e r   m o t h e r  appearedintheChambersofthisCourt,alongwithherbaby, who is only 7 months old.

7. True that thepetitionerisinjudicialcustodyfrom 21.11.2023 onwards.
He belongs to Assam.

When the survivor girl became pregnant, he absconded toAssam,and he could be arrested and brought back  t o   K e r a l a   a f t e r   m u c h   e f f o r t   f r o m   t h e   p a r t   o f   P o l i c e .
